Errors.NoFxmaster: GURPS Combat Drama needs FXMaster 8 or later to be active.
Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can play Combat Drama effects.

enabled.Name: Enable Combat Drama
enabled.Hint: Master switch for all effects from this module.

combatOnly.Name: Only during combat
combatOnly.Hint: Only play effects while a combat is running on that scene.

whoTriggers.Name: Who triggers effects
whoTriggers.Hint: Whose wounds and rolls cause effects. Effects are scene-wide, so everyone on the scene sees them.

skipHidden.Name: Ignore hidden tokens
skipHidden.Hint: Don't play effects for actors whose tokens are all hidden, so players aren't tipped off.

intensity.Name: Intensity
intensity.Hint: How strong the shake, tint and glow are. 1 is the default.

durationScale.Name: Duration
durationScale.Hint: Multiplier for how long each effect stays on screen.

rollDelay.Name: Roll effect delay (ms)
rollDelay.Hint: Wait before critical success/failure effects. Set around 2500 if you use Dice So Nice, so the effect lands after the dice settle.

event_majorWound.Name: Effect: Major wound
event_majorWound.Hint: A single injury of more than 1/2 HP (B420).

event_collapse.Name: Effect: 0 HP
event_collapse.Hint: Dropping to 0 HP or less, when consciousness rolls begin (B419).

event_deathCheck.Name: Effect: Death check
event_deathCheck.Hint: Reaching each new multiple of -1×HP, when a HT roll to survive is needed (B419).

event_exhausted.Name: Effect: 0 FP
event_exhausted.Hint: Dropping to 0 FP or less, on the verge of collapse (B426).

event_critSuccess.Name: Effect: Critical success
event_critSuccess.Hint: Any targeted roll that is a critical success.

event_critFailure.Name: Effect: Critical failure
event_critFailure.Hint: Any targeted roll that is a critical failure.
